arxiv-1711-06078.title: Two Birds with One Stone: Transforming and Generating Facial Images with Iterative GAN
arxiv-1711-06078.creator: Dan Ma, Bin Liu, Zhao Kang, Jiayu Zhou, Jianke Zhu, Zenglin Xu
arxiv-1711-06078.description: A 2017 arXiv research paper by Dan Ma, Bin Liu, Zhao Kang, Jiayu Zhou, Jianke Zhu, Zenglin Xu. Generating high fidelity identity-preserving faces with different facial attributes has a wide range of applications. Although a number of generative models have been developed to tackle this problem, there is still much room for further improvement. In paticular, the current solutions usually ignore the perceptual information of images, which we argue that it benefits the output of a high-quality image while preserving the identity information, especially in facial attributes learning area.

arxiv-2307-16615.title: Well-posedness and simulation of weak solutions to the time-fractional Fokker–Planck equation with general forcing Thanks: The author is supported by the state of Upper Austria. Thanks: ∗ Corresponding author: Marvin Fritz
arxiv-2307-16615.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by . In this paper, we investigate the well-posedness of weak solutions to the time-fractional Fokker–Planck equation. Its dynamics is governed by anomalous diffusion, and we consider the most general case of space-time dependent forces. Consequently, the fractional derivatives appear on the right-hand side of the equation, and they cannot be brought to the left-hand side, which would have been preferable from an analytical perspective.

arxiv-2310-19584.creator: in Memory of Professor Decio Levi
arxiv-2310-19584.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by in Memory of Professor Decio Levi. In recent work, we presented the construction of a family of difference equations associated with the Stieltjes continued fraction expansion of a certain function on a hyperelliptic curve of genus g g . As well as proving that each such discrete system is an integrable map in the Liouville sense, we also showed it to be an algebraic completely integrable system.

arxiv-2311-01526.title: ATGNN: Audio Tagging Graph Neural Network
arxiv-2311-01526.creator: Shubhr Singh, Christian J. Steinmetz, Emmanouil Benetos, Huy Phan, Dan Stowell
arxiv-2311-01526.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Shubhr Singh, Christian J. Steinmetz, Emmanouil Benetos, Huy Phan, Dan Stowell. Deep learning models such as CNNs and Transformers have achieved impressive performance for end-to-end audio tagging. Recent works have shown that despite stacking multiple layers, the receptive field of CNNs remains severely limited. Transformers on the other hand are able to map global context through self-attention, but treat the spectrogram as a sequence of patches which is not flexible enough to capture irregular audio objects.

arxiv-2408-12479.description: Abstract This work presents a matrix-free finite element solver for finite-strain elasticity adopting an h ​ p hp -multigrid preconditioner. Compared to classical algorithms relying on a global sparse matrix, matrix-free solution strategies significantly reduce memory traffic by repeated evaluation of the finite element integrals.

arxiv-2411-19577.description: Abstract With the rapid development of autonomous vehicles, there is an increasing demand for scenario-based testing to simulate diverse driving scenarios. arxiv-2508-04811.creator: Lin Jiang, Yu Yang, Guang Wang
arxiv-2508-04811.description: Abstract Order dispatch systems play a vital role in ride-hailing services, which directly influence operator revenue, driver profit, and passenger experience. Most existing work focuses on improving system efficiency in terms of operator revenue, which may cause a bad experience for both passengers and drivers.

arxiv-2511-18144.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Sovan Boxi, Saikat Das, Nayantara Gupta. The highest-energy cosmic neutrino detected by the ARCA detector of KM3NeT has reignited the quest to pinpoint the sources of ultrahigh-energy cosmic rays (UHECRs; E ≳ 0.1 E\gtrsim 0.1 EeV). By uncovering the associated multimessenger signals, we investigate the origin of the 220 PeV ν μ \nu_{\mu} event KM3-230213A from a transient source that accelerated cosmic rays to ∼ 10 \sim 10 EeV.

pmc-11509895.title: A Simple Analysis of the Second (Extra) Disulfide Bridge of VHHs
pmc-11509895.creator: Carla Martins, Fabrice Gardebien, Aravindan Arun Nadaradjane, Julien Diharce, Alexandre G de Brevern, Anna Marabotti, Takeshi Kikuchi
pmc-11509895.description: Camelids produce a special type of antibody, known as VHHs, that has lost the VL domain, providing a more optimised VH domain. This particular highly stable antibody domain has interesting properties for biotechnological development. Ordinarily, those molecules possess only one disulphide bridge, but surprisingly, at least a quarter of these VHHs have a second one.

pmc-11605454.title: Neuronal splicing of the unmethylated histone H3K4 reader, PHF21A, prevents excessive synaptogenesis
pmc-11605454.creator: Masayoshi Nagai, Robert S Porter, Maxwell Miyasato, Aijia Wang, Cecilia M Gavilan, Elizabeth D Hughes, Michael C Wu, Thomas L Saunders, Shigeki Iwase
pmc-11605454.description: PHF21A is a histone-binding protein that recognizes unmethylated histone H3K4, the reaction product of LSD1 histone demethylase. PHF21A and LSD1 form a complex, and both undergo neuron-specific microexon splicing. The PHF21A neuronal microexon interferes with nucleosome binding, whereas the LSD1 neuronal microexon weakens H3K4 demethylation activity and can alter the substrate specificity to H3K9 or H4K20.

pmc-12610626.title: SFA-DETR: An Efficient UAV Detection Algorithm with Joint Spatial–Frequency-Domain Awareness
pmc-12610626.creator: Peinan He, Xu Wang
pmc-12610626.description: Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) detection often faces challenges such as small target size, loss of textural details, and interference from complex backgrounds. pmc-13157432.description: IntroductionOutcome assessment after mild traumatic brain injury (mTBI) has largely focused on acute injury severity, while the role of pre-injury health has received comparatively less attention. The American Society of Anesthesiologists (ASA) physical status classification provides a simple measure of pre-existing health and comorbidity that may be relevant to early outcomes after trauma.

uslaw-usc-t10-s2672.title: 10 U.S.C. § 2672 — Protection of buildings, grounds, property, and persons
uslaw-usc-t10-s2672.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t10-s2672.description: United States Code, Title 10 (Armed Forces); Part IV (Service, Supply, And Property); Chapter 159 (Real Property; Related Personal Property; And Lease Of Non-Excess Property). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Secretary of Defense Responsibility.— The Secretary of Defense shall protect the buildings, grounds, and property that are under the jurisdiction, custody, or control of the Department of Defense and the persons.

uslaw-usc-t10-s9286.title: 10 U.S.C. § 9286 — Korea Defense Service Medal
uslaw-usc-t10-s9286.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t10-s9286.description: United States Code, Title 10 (Armed Forces); Part II (Personnel); Chapter 937 (Decorations And Awards). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) The Secretary of the Air Force shall issue a campaign medal, to be known as the Korea Defense Service Medal, to each person who while a member of the Air Force or the Space Force served in the Republic of Korea.
